title: Work tab: a "show closed" option that also lists completed, cancelled and superseded items
outcome: The Work tab offers a "show closed" option. With it on, the Engram source lists closed work too (engram work ls --all: completed, cancelled, superseded), with each row's lifecycle shown as it already is (grey for closed); with it off, the view stays as today (open work only). The option is per view, explicit, and a changed setting starts a fresh read like a filter change.
acceptance: Work tab: a "show closed" option that also lists completed, cancelled and superseded items is done
